issues.legal_issue: An owner whose land is taken before publication of the acquisition notification is entitled to additional compensation from the date of possession when the acquisition is not invalidated.
material_facts: The landowners’ land was taken into possession before publication of the acquisition notification.
The notification was published later, and the award was made after possession had been taken.
The landowners did not challenge the advance taking of possession in court.
issues.conclusion: The landowners were entitled to the additional amount calculated on market value from the date possession was taken, even though possession preceded publication of the notification; the petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 23(1-A) of the Land Acquisition Act, read in light of its purpose of mitigating the hardship caused when an owner is deprived of use of land before compensation is awarded, entitles the owner to additional compensation from the date possession is taken even if possession precedes publication of the notification under Section 4(1). The expression “whichever is earlier” must be construed to avoid defeating that purpose. The Court cited no earlier cases. It noted that a different result may follow if the owner challenges the notification and the court upholds its invalidity, because the State would not then have taken possession in law under the notification contemplated by Section 23(1-A).

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_claim and possession_precedes_notification and award_follows_possession and acquisition_not_invalidated

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_claim: A claimant seeks compensation in a land-acquisition proceeding.
predicates.possession_precedes_notification: The acquiring authority took possession of the land before the acquisition notification was published.
predicates.award_follows_possession: The compensation award was made after possession had been taken.
predicates.acquisition_not_invalidated: The claimant did not successfully challenge the acquisition notification as invalid.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks compensation in a land-acquisition proceeding, possession preceded publication of the notification, the award followed possession, and the acquisition was not invalidated, the claimant is entitled to additional compensation from the date possession was taken.
